title: rehan-remade/universal-modder
why_read: An ambitious experiment in using Claude Code plus generative asset tools to automatically mod arbitrary PC games, interesting as a demo of agentic tool-use chains even if practically rough.
analysis: Universal Modder is a set of skills and tools that let Claude Code attempt to reverse-engineer and modify almost any PC game you own, generating new art, 3D assets, and audio via the fal generative media API, then testing the mod in-game. It's an interesting example of chaining an LLM coding agent with reverse engineering tools and generative content APIs to automate a traditionally very manual, game-specific hobby. The practical reliability of fully automated game reverse-engineering across arbitrary titles is questionable, and there are likely legal/ToS gray areas around modifying commercial game binaries this way, but as a technical experiment in agentic tool orchestration it's notable.
